result.title: No Cones, No Duals: A Fast and Scalable Solver for NRSfM
result.comment: 21 pages, 14 figures, 19 tables, Accepted for publication at IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV), 2027
result.summary: Non-rigid structure from motion (NRSfM) aims to recover camera motion and time-varying 3D shape from tracked 2D image measurements. Recent high-performing methods show that shape-space factorization remains highly effective for this task. These methods often use costly solvers for two key steps. First, a semidefinite programming (SDP) cone solver to perform Euclidean correction. Next, an alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) solver to recover the low-rank shape. These steps often scale poorly to long sequences and dense point tracks. We propose a fast, scalable NRSfM solver that avoids these costly steps. For rotation estimation, we introduce a differentiable Euclidean correction that directly optimizes small factors for each sequence. A row-polar projection then maps each estimated camera block to the closest row-orthonormal matrix. For shape estimation, we introduce an unrolled spectral-proximal solver. It combines reprojection-gradient steps with weighted singular-value shrinkage in the reshuffled shape domain. This solver further uses FISTA-style restart and continuation. The spectral shrinkage operator itself is classical, but we embed it in a fixed differentiable solver, while preserving NRSfM's geometric constraints. The proposed approach is category-agnostic, requires no external training data, and maps naturally to modern accelerator-friendly linear algebra primitives. Across sparse, dense, noisy, missing-data, and long-sequence benchmarks, our solver achieves substantial speedups with competitive reconstruction accuracy, including 7x-1000x runtime improvements on dense sequences with 28,887 tracked points.

AI.brief_summary: 提出一种快速可扩展的 NRSfM 求解器：用可微欧氏校正替代 SDP 锥求解估计相机旋转，用展开的谱近端求解器（重投影梯度步 + 加权奇异值收缩、FISTA 重启与 continuation）替代 ADMM 恢复低秩形状。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「展开的可微近端求解器 + 重启/continuation」把迭代优化固定为前向可微的状态更新序列，可能为 LVR 中循环式 latent 状态更新与几何、低秩约束的施加方式提供可供核查的方法线索。
